module: Freeform delivery submodule that tracks the odometer of vehicles marked trackOdometer in the delivery definition. It reads the value via core_vehicleBridge (getRootPartOdometer), computes the distance traveled since the start, displays a message in the task list and fails the delivery if the distance exceeds maxOdometer.
notes: Odometer values are in meters; the display follows the uiUnitLength setting (m or ft, 1 m = 3.2808399 ft).
A negative value (-1) means the odometer could not be read.
Reading is asynchronous (requestValue); isSetupComplete() becomes true when all initial readings have come back.
At setup, if vehicleDef.partsInitialized is false, the command partCondition.initConditions(nil, 0, nil, 0) is sent to the vehicle, then partsInitialized becomes true.
Exceeding maxOdometer calls gameplay_freeformDelivery_freeformDelivery.finish(true, reason) if the delivery is active.

setup.desc: Resets the tracking then, for each vehicle of delivery.vehicles with trackOdometer, requests the starting odometer from the vehicle. maxOdometer (optional) comes from the vehicle definition.

delivery.desc: Delivery data with the vehicles array.

isSetupComplete.desc: Returns whether all initial odometer requests have received a response.

returns.desc: true when no request is pending.

update.desc: Called every frame; every 1/8 s, requests the odometer of each tracked vehicle again and fails the delivery if the distance traveled exceeds maxOdometer.

getOdometerData.desc: Returns the tracking data of a vehicle.

vehId.desc: Object ID of the vehicle in the game.

returns.desc: {deliveryVehicleId, startingOdometer, currentOdometer, maxOdometer, requestPending} or nil.

getOdometerDataByDeliveryId.desc: Like getOdometerData but searching by the vehicle's ID in the delivery definition.

deliveryVehicleId.desc: Vehicle ID in the delivery (inferred from code).

updateTasklistMessage.desc: Updates (or removes) the odometer message in the task list for the player's vehicle. Only sends SetTasklistTask if the text has changed.

cleanup.desc: Clears the tracking and removes the odometer message from the task list (DiscardTasklistItem).
